hardsub_cover.scope: Cover burned-in (hard) subtitles when re-voicing a video (0.9.10), one of the gaps named in the 0.9.9 summary. src/lib/voiceover.mjs hardsubCoverSegments builds an honest cover over the bottom regionPct% of the frame (default 13%, clamped 10–40; Studio offers Low ~12% / Medium ~18% / High ~26% height choices): mode blur (split/crop/boxblur/overlay) or band (translucent black drawbox), inserted into buildVoiceover BEFORE the new subtitles are burned, so new captions stay crisp. Wired into media.dub, media.retheme and media.voiceover (submit validation, handler pass-through, rendered.hardsubCover recorded in dub/retheme reports); Studio selects in the Retheme (default blur) and Voiceover (default off) panels; the AI Director routes dub/retheme with hardsubCover blur by default. This is a COVER, not inpainting — the UI and guide say so plainly; true subtitle removal/restoration is still not implemented. LIVE VERIFIED in sandbox: retheme task on a video WITH burned-in Vietnamese subtitles (the earlier JFK retheme output) + new tea-culture script + cover blur completed: report hardsubCover {mode:blur, regionPct:22, applied:true}, 0 overflows, output 80.04s == source; frame at 33s shows the old coffee subtitles fully illegible under the blur while the new tea subtitles render crisply on top and the rest of the frame is untouched (deliverables VIDEO-Che-Phu-De-Cung_JFK-Tra-Viet_che-mo.mp4 + HS-TRUOC/HS-SAU frames). Quick-edit (Concat path) does not have the cover yet.

smooth_speech_assembly.scope: Smoother dubbed speech for media.dub + media.retheme (0.9.11), after the user judged the voiceover choppy and not mouth-synced. Shared assembleSpeechTrack in integration-host: (1) groupSpeechSegments (media-ai.mjs, pure/deterministic) merges neighbouring windows (gap <= 0.7s, <= 600 chars, <= 30s span) so TTS reads continuous passages instead of cold-starting every window; subtitles keep the original per-segment windows; (2) tempo cap lowered 1.35 -> 1.25 with the same borrow-the-following-pause room rule; (3) every placed group gets 30ms/60ms in/out fades so joins do not click; (4) a very quiet pink-noise room-tone bed (lowpass 500Hz, volume 0.012) replaces dead digital silence between groups. Reports record speechGroups + per-segment group/tempo. LIVE VERIFIED on the JFK tea retheme (same inputs as the 0.9.10 proof): readings dropped 11 -> 3 groups, dead-silence regions (silencedetect -50dB/0.25s) dropped 11 -> 3, max tempo 1.0; total quiet time unchanged (~65.5s of 80s) because speech still only occupies the original talking windows — stated plainly. NOT addressed: lip-sync — mouths still move with the original language; true lip-sync needs a dedicated model (licensing + hardware) and remains a separate future item, disclosed in the in-app guide.

studio_effects.scope: CapCut-style EFFECTS mode added to Media Studio (0.9.12) after the user pointed out the Studio had no effects section. New operation media.effects + src/lib/media-effects.mjs: a curated catalog of 17 deterministic presets in 4 groups (frame: blurred-background 9:16 vertical / 16:9 horizontal pads; colour: vivid, bright, warm, cool, black-and-white, vintage, vignette, sharpen; motion: slow zoom in/out via zoompan, 1.25x speed-up, 0.8x slow-down with matched atempo, fade in/out on picture and sound; text: opening title + lower-third name card rendered from a generated ASS file through the same subtitles burn path as dubbing). One ffmpeg graph in a fixed order (speed -> pad -> zoom -> colour chain -> text burn); max 8 per task; inapplicable effects are reported in effects-report.json, never silently dropped; QA gate via the shared quality checker; the handler returns its report (the engine reads result.qa — a first live run caught a missing return and it was fixed). LIVE VERIFIED through the real API on the 1280x720 JFK clip: pad-vertical + vivid + vignette + title + lower-third completed, output 406x720, 80.04s == source, QA passed; the 2s frame shows the blurred bands, the big title and the boxed name card. Studio now has 10 modes; the earlier CapCut shell test was updated to expect 10 modes/panels.

karaoke_captions.scope: Word-by-word karaoke captions for media.dub + media.retheme. CORRECTED in 0.9.14 after an independent re-measurement (prompted by the user asking whether text and voice were really even) exposed a real sync defect in 0.9.13: word times were spread across the ORIGINAL segment windows while the grouped speech track reads each passage continuously at the start of its group — offsets up to seconds, worst in long pauses (voice said a word at 1.19s, its caption lit at 4.96s). Fix: alignKaraokeWords anchors every word to its speech GROUP’s real span [groupStart, groupStart + voiceSeconds/tempo] taken from the assembly segReports; Whisper word timings (transcribeWordsLocal, whisper.cpp -ojf over the final speech track) refine boundaries INSIDE that span only; fallback is a proportional split of the speech span; reports keep captionStyle/captionTiming disclosure. Dialogue windows now follow the voice, not the source windows. RE-MEASURED independently (fresh Whisper pass over the delivered videos own audio, one-to-one word matching): median absolute offset 0.12s, mean 0.33s; frame at 1.05s shows exactly the spoken word yellow and the next word white. Timing text is always the scripts own words. Not yet applied to story/tts-video outputs.

lip_sync.scope: Researched 2026-10-18 from primary sources (repos, LICENSE files, model cards). CORRECTION of the first-pass summary: MuseTalk IS commercially licensable — code MIT ("no limitation for both academic and commercial usage") and its weights carry an explicit statement that they are available for any purpose, even commercially; diligence items: the S3FD dependency license is unstated (replace or clear before shipping) and repo test data must not be bundled. SadTalker code+own checkpoints are Apache 2.0 but it solves image-to-talking-head (not dubbing an existing video) and its GFPGAN enhancer needs review. Wav2Lip is research/non-commercial only; LatentSync weights have no explicit license statement and need 8-18GB VRAM; LivePortrait bundles InsightFace models restricted to non-commercial research; EchoMimic V3 is Apache but needs ~12GB VRAM; Hallo2 weights are an unlicensed mix. MuseTalk was still NOT shipped: on typical customer machines (no strong GPU) it renders about 37 minutes per 1 minute of video on a 4GB laptop GPU, has no official CPU path, and outputs 256x256 faces with jitter — not sellable as a local feature today. Practical routes: a cloud lip-sync API slot (HeyGen Lip Sync API from $0.84/min) under the same optional-provider pattern as FPT/HeyGen TTS, or a self-hosted MuseTalk backend on rented cloud GPUs.
lip_sync.note: Researched, NOT built. MuseTalk (MIT code; weights declared usable for any purpose, even commercially) is the legally clean candidate, but it is not viable on typical customer laptops (~37 min render per 1 min of video on a 4GB GPU, no official CPU path, 256x256 faces). No third-party lip-sync API is embedded: their terms forbid reselling the API as a standalone or white-label feature without an enterprise agreement, and the owner rejected casual API embedding on legal-risk grounds. A future route, only if the owner asks, is self-hosted MuseTalk on rented cloud GPUs.

Ten built-in fields (thoi-su, kinh-doanh, cong-nghe, the-thao, giai-tri, suc-khoe, am-thuc, du-lich, xe-co, giao-duc) in src/lib/news-fields.mjs, each with classification keywords and a Google News RSS topic query. The guide text is written into the project brief (idea) and the checklist into the goals, so the Council/PM/Workers plan and execute FROM the repo's own instructions; finished work returns via the existing Pull Request flow, and Vercel deploys run from the same workspace (an imported .vercel link makes deploys target the existing Vercel project). features.news_radar: News Radar tab: 20 selectable fields (dropdown, per-user), Tin nổi bật top-scored panel, per-card Làm video / Viết bài phân tích actions that start orchestrator runs ending at the boss approval gate; video posts gain deterministic field hashtags; articles are produced with caption + hashtags and delivered as publish drafts after approval

features.office_in_idea_studio: Văn phòng AI nằm ngay trong Idea Studio (cạnh ô chat tiếp nhận, bảng task ở dưới trang); tab AI Team riêng đã bỏ. Phòng 2D là mặc định — bot luôn hiện; phòng 3D chỉ bật khi bấm nút và chỉ che lớp 2D sau khi khung hình 3D đầu tiên vẽ thành công, kèm canh gác 9 giây tự quay về 2D nếu 3D lỗi (vá lỗi hộp đen không thấy bot).
features.publish_platform_stats: Publish chỉ còn thống kê + vòng khép kín: thẻ số liệu theo từng nền tảng (YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Threads, X, Zalo và nền tảng khác nếu có bản ghi) — bài đã đăng, lượt xem, thích, bình luận, chia sẻ, theo dõi mới khi nền tảng trả về (không có thì để —). Đã bỏ wizard GitHub/Vercel/Supabase khỏi tab Publish.
features.radar_field_tiles: Radar tin: hàng ô bo tròn chọn nhanh lĩnh vực (20 lĩnh vực) phía trên ô chọn; đã bỏ panel quản lý Nguồn tin khỏi tab Radar — lưới tin + Tin nổi bật như bản mẫu.
features.idea_move_leftovers_fixed: Bản vá các chỗ sót khi gom AI Team vào Idea Studio (bắt được nhờ kiểm độc lập sau 0.9.36): vòng cập nhật văn phòng 4 giây và vòng thực thi task 1,5 giây nay neo đúng trang Idea (văn phòng tự làm mới liên tục, không đứng im sau lần vẽ đầu); xử lý click bảng task gắn đúng trang Idea (bấm thẻ task mở chi tiết, menu ⋮ dùng được); toàn bộ CSS bảng task (theme tối + sáng) đổi neo từ trang AI Team cũ sang #page-idea nên bảng có định dạng trở lại; nút AI Team và mục rủi ro trong Project Map dẫn về Idea Studio; Hướng dẫn hết chỉ dẫn nguồn RSS đã gỡ.
features.tam19_fleet_body: Đội bot tài khoản dùng thân robot mới GuardianViet TAM19 (P09) do chủ sở hữu cung cấp: GLB 2,6MB, 5 clip (Idle, Walk, Greeting, Approve, InspectTablet — việc = InspectTablet, duyệt = Approve, lỗi = Idle trong chuồng chích điện), nhuộm màu theo hãng vào mắt phát sáng + men ngọc lam. TAM19 là hoạt hình theo node (không skin) — nhân bản nguyên cây node cho từng bot.
features.office_isometric_room: Phông phòng 2D mới: phòng vũ trụ isometric render từ source Python do chủ sở hữu cung cấp (render lại 3000×2000 ngay trên máy chủ build) — 7 bàn có biển tên (SẾP LÂM, RESEARCH, CONTENT, DESIGN, VIDEO, CODE, QUALITY), phòng nạp năng lượng + phòng chích điện bằng kính, cầu hologram giữa phòng. Tọa độ trạm 2D được chiếu toán học từ scene gốc và đối chiếu với ảnh render, bot đứng đúng bàn/buồng. Phòng 3D (bấm nút) giữ nguyên bản cũ.
features.office_declutter: Gọn mặt tiền văn phòng 2D (theo phản hồi "rối nùi"): bot tài khoản có hình robot riêng (đầu trắng, ăng-ten, mắt màu hãng, thân màu hãng) thay hình người chung; bảng tên rút gọn theo hãng + số thứ tự khi trùng (ChatGPT 1/2/3, Gemini); bỏ nhãn trạng thái lặp trên từng bot (chỉ còn nhãn khi đang làm việc hoặc bị chích điện — chi tiết đầy đủ nằm ở dòng trạng thái dưới phòng); chip trạm nhỏ và trong hơn; bỏ khay bàn giả dưới chip trạm vì tranh phòng đã có bàn thật.
features.office_bot_sprites: Bot tài khoản trong phòng 2D là hình render từ chính model GuardianViet TAM19 (GLB do chủ sở hữu cung cấp): 15 sprite (5 màu hãng: mặc định/ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Antigravity × 3 tư thế đứng/chăm chú xem tablet khi đang làm việc/đang đi), render bằng engine three.js của app từ file tam19.glb, góc nhìn 3/4 khớp phòng isometric, nhuộm màu theo đúng quy tắc bản 3D (mắt phát sáng + men ngọc lam lerp về màu hãng). Bot đang làm việc hiện tư thế xem tablet, di chuyển hiện tư thế đi, tài khoản chưa xác minh hiện mờ nhẹ. Thay hẳn hình robot SVG tự vẽ của 0.9.39.
features.office_bot_sit_typing: Bot vừa tỉ lệ phòng + ngồi gõ phím khi làm việc (theo yêu cầu chủ sở hữu): sprite bot thu từ 84px xuống 62px, neo chân cùng mặt sàn để khớp tỉ lệ bàn ghế trong tranh phòng và ngang tầm nhân vật Sếp; tư thế làm việc đổi từ đứng xem tablet sang NGỒI GHẾ GÕ PHÍM — dựng thế ngồi trực tiếp từ các khớp hông/gối/vai/cùi chỏ của model TAM19 (hạ thân 0,31 đơn vị cho chân gập đúng ghế render cùng), 6 khung hình tay gõ luân phiên phát thành hoạt hình steps trong phòng 2D; bot di chuyển vẫn dùng tư thế đi, bot nghỉ vẫn đứng ở buồng sạc.
features.cli_native_bin_fix: Claude Code 2.x ships a native bin/claude.exe (no cli.js); managed-cli now accepts publisher-declared native binaries as well as JS launchers and probes per-user install locations (~/.local/bin, %APPDATA%/npm) so a stale app PATH no longer blocks login. Verified by regression tests with the real 2.1.304 package layout.
features.antigravity_detection: Antigravity launcher now also probes the WinGet Packages payload folder, %LOCALAPPDATA%/agy variants and Programs folders; when only the desktop IDE is present the app says so explicitly (IDE != CLI) instead of a bare not-found.
features.provider_presets: OpenAI-compatible dialog gains one-click presets (DeepSeek, xAI Grok, Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter, Together) plus keyless local servers (Ollama, LM Studio on loopback).
features.reception_meeting_feed: Idea Studio intake desk shows a live Đội AI bàn việc feed rendered deterministically from recorded orchestrator runs/steps and operator notes — real events only, simulated steps keep their simulated labels.
features.operator_channel: Optional external-operator channel: one revocable token stored as SHA-256 hash only, scoped permissions (run / note / approvePublish default OFF), four endpoints under /api/operator/ext; server stays loopback-only, remote reach is the owner private network (e.g. Tailscale Serve).
features.project_map_shell_fix: Fixed a stray extra in radar.html that closed the app shell early and pushed Skills/Engines/Project Map/Publish/Guide below the 100vh shell (home page looked empty). Guarded by a tab-fragment tag-balance test.
features.kokoro_tts: Local English neural TTS (Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0) installed on demand from the official npm package kokoro-js 1.2.1 plus the Hugging Face model repo; the quantized model SHA-256 is verified against the repo LFS oid after download. Wired into the Studio voice picker for dub and retheme (English targets only — other languages hit the honest voice-language guard; Vietnamese stays on Piper) and into the orchestrator dub pipeline. Synthesis live-verified headless on Linux producing real 24kHz WAV; Windows run still needs the owner acceptance pass like every local engine.
features.radar_full_text: News cards can carry full article text, Miniflux-style: readability extraction on scan (max 3 new cards per scan, per-source opt-out, only when the summary is short), an in-card reader plus fetch-on-demand endpoint, and the news script writers (simulated and gateway) now write from the full text instead of the short summary.
features.opencode_engine: OpenCode (MIT, opencode-ai 1.19.3) joins the engine registry: one-click npm runtime install from the Engines tab, headless task adapter via opencode run --format json using the owner configured model connection — including LOCAL models over any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama/LM Studio). Locked by default behind the same explicit unsafe-host opt-in as mini-SWE-agent. The live model loop is NOT yet verified end-to-end in the development sandbox (its proxy blocks OpenCode's provider runtime) — owner Windows acceptance run pending.
features.account_pool_rotation: Account pool + quota rotation (0.9.44): connections of the same AI kind form a pool; providers.ask resolves the role's pinned account first, and on a quota/rate-limit signal (HTTP 429 or a quota message from the vendor CLI/API) it cools that account down until its reset (parsed from the provider error when present, else 60 min for account kinds / 2 min for API kinds) and retries the SAME call on the next pooled account whose verified registry contains the same model. Non-quota errors never fail over. Every quota hit, switch and pool exhaustion is recorded in account-pool.json and rendered in the reception meeting feed; Connections cards show pool size and cooldown state. Scope: text inference through providers.ask (Founder/Council/Worker/Reviewer and all pipelines). External code engines (OpenCode/mini-SWE) and image generation keep their pinned connection in this version. Accounts are only the owner's own logged-in accounts; the pool never creates accounts or shares credentials.
features.tam19_p13_office: TAM-19 P13 office (0.9.45): the AI office is populated by the owner's own GuardianViet TAM-19 P13 model (GLB SHA-256 85a7e95d11b4000be2ba152f5c5bb446eaeb874fb4cdc7e7446a96b008ed1900, supplied by the owner 2026-10-20). All 2D office sprites (idle/walk/seated-typing sheets, 5 provider tints) were re-rendered from the P13 GLB; the 3D room loads the same P13 GLB with its 5 baked clips (Idle/Walk/Greeting/Approve/InspectTablet). The office always shows 10 robots: fleet bots with a connected account sit at their desks (seated typing sheet while working); the remaining robot slots stand in the energy room as honestly-labelled empty slots ('cho tai khoan') and move to a desk automatically when an account is linked. Errored bots still go to the electric cage. Office state remains real app state only.
features.office_3d_motion: 3D office is the default office view (0.9.46): TAM-19 P13 robots visibly WALK between stations playing the GLB Walk clip and SIT at their desks (programmatic Hip/Knee/Ankle bend over the InspectTablet work clip; lounge grid 2 rows x 5 in 3D). Root-cause fix: the static server mime map lacked '.mjs', so /office-clip.mjs was served as application/octet-stream and browsers refused to execute it — the 3D clip-selection logic never loaded on any machine since 0.9.31 and GLB robots only ever played Idle. team.js also gained an inline fallback clip rule so a future module-load failure degrades honestly instead of freezing animation choice. The 2D office remains available via the toggle (choice remembered); 3D load failure still falls back to 2D.
features.operator_diagnosis: Read-only diagnosis door on the external operator channel (0.9.47): GET /api/operator/ext/run/:id returns one run in full — every step with its state and the ORIGINAL error, payloads projected to small scalar summaries; GET /api/operator/ext/journal returns the run feed plus operator notes; GET /api/operator/ext/connections returns a secret-free connection projection (kind, label, hasSecret, verified, availability/pool state; a locked vault answers {vaultLocked:true} instead of an error). Same operator token, no new scope: the owner's existing token works unchanged, so the outside coordinator can read failures directly instead of asking the owner to relay logs.
features.connection_rename: Mọi kết nối — kể cả tài khoản đăng nhập Codex/Claude/Gemini/Antigravity — sửa được Tên hiển thị ngay trong hộp thoại (nút Lưu tên hiển thị, POST /api/connections/:id/name); tên robot trong văn phòng lấy theo tên kết nối nên đổi tên kết nối là robot đổi tên theo.
features.reception_r7: Named role selection, approved scope, bounded retries, real product catalogue, local receipt distinct from public publishing, execution preflight.
features.radar_r7: Persisted custom categories, optional AI query suggestions, scoped/freshness scan, per-source errors, public-URL checks and pagination. Live news network unavailable in verification.
features.video_r7: explicit caption-only MP4/SRT; installed local voices detected; optional Windows SAPI unverified on Windows; paid voice never automatic

features.robot_unfinished_task: Seat retained across waiting/review of the same unfinished job; no fake typing during waiting.
features.media_story_concat: Editable Concat API 0.2 timeline and native final export; FFmpeg prepares independent animated still clips; fixtures only tested for this new story path.
features.source_ui_media_attach: v0.9.67: delegated Radar click under strict CSP; local idea image/video file upload bridges into Media Studio; requires active Core, no implied AI visual analysis
features.factory_skills: six role skills added; actual workers depend on model/engine and credentials
features.local_voice_recovery: managed and legacy Piper discovery, fresh status, default local provider, same-run retry and idempotent post-setup continuation
features.reception_public_conversation: actual public worker/reviewer messages and separate progress; old customer form removed
features.image_account_transport: bounded image RPC above 2MB, capability preflight and safe per-source reasons; live account entitlement not tested
features.github_import: noninteractive scoped credentials, bounded shallow clone, progress jobs, reload recovery, exact project selection and verified team copy
features.social_extended: 17-channel catalog; manual verified tokens for Threads text/X text/Zalo OA articles, per-draft account/content approval, X cost opt-in, durable no-replay on uncertain writes; other extra channels text export only
features.multiplatform_guide: in-app onboarding for cloud, AI, official social OAuth/manual tokens and export-only channels; help links from Connections/Publish; outdated mandatory manual cloud setup removed
